title: A slow sphere in thicker fluid
hook: Change fluid viscosity and predict drag force.
misconception: drag force stays fixed when fluid viscosity doubles.
objective: Apply F = 6πηrv to compare drag force when fluid viscosity changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With creeping flow around a sphere with fixed radius and speed, F = 6πηrv. When fluid viscosity doubles, drag force becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model F = 6πηrv; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider creeping flow around a sphere with fixed radius and speed, with a nonzero initial result. If fluid viscosity triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on drag force?
recall.why: Apply F = 6πηrv under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
